AuthorizedUser.title: AuthorizedUser
AuthorizedUser.description: A school member authorized by the administrator to participate in the lockout activity and access group forms.

email.description: School email address of the user.

groupName.description: The group or cohort the user belongs to.

role.description: Role of the user (admin or member).

addedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user was added.

verifiedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user was verified.

TaskSubmission.title: TaskSubmission
TaskSubmission.description: A completed or in-progress single submission for one of the 16 bingo tasks.

groupName.description: Group name that submitted the task.

responseSummary.description: Summary or reflection submitted via Google Form.

formResponseId.description: Unique Google Form response ID if available.

Group.title: Group
Group.description: A group or PLC working together through the 16 tasks.

description.description: Description of the group or department.

completedTasks.description: Comma-separated list or count of completed tasks.

AppSettings.title: AppSettings
AppSettings.description: Global configuration for the Lockout Tracker Workspace integration.

targetDocOrSheetId.description: ID or URL of the central Google Sheet or Doc.

appsScriptUrl.description: Published Google Apps Script Web App URL.

/authorized_users/{userId}.description: List of authorized school users with verification status and group assignments.

/task_submissions/{submissionId}.description: Centralized form submissions and lockout states for the 16 tasks.

/groups/{groupId}.description: Registered groups participating in the bingo activity.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Administrator configuration and Workspace target document settings.
